purpose: Define cross-layer morphology rechecks and alternans interpretation policy for the Land-first myocardium plan.

layers.description: Fixed-strain prescribed-Ca plus Land source-stress twitch.
Low/normal/high afterload minimal loaded chamber family.
Owner-selected mechanics backend and passive/generalized-force path.
Active-stiffness partitioned coupling compared with local reference.
Full closed-loop LV/RV Land evaluation with selected atrial bridge.

layerConsistencyGate.rule: A later layer must re-report the upstream Phase 2B timing/shape metrics and explain deviations. A pass cannot rely on downstream coupling destroying the Level 2 mechanism.

legacyReproduction.description: Reproduce legacy activeStress alternans under a fixed protocol before claiming improvement.

newMyocardiumCheck.description: Run the new myocardium under the same fixed protocol and report branch behavior, clamp/event surfaces, and morphology.

secondOrderReferenceRequired.description: Final no-alternans interpretation must not rely on BE alone. SDIRK2 or an equivalent second-order reference must be available before treating alternans disappearance as robust.

alternansPolicy.beOnlyInterpretation: BE-only disappearance may be reported as smoke evidence only, not as a final robustness claim.
